scripts:
create path (sling:OrderedFolder) /content
create path (sling:Folder) /conf
create path (sling:OrderedFolder) /content/dam
create path (sling:Folder) /var/studio
create path (sling:Folder) /var/studio/forms
create path (sling:Folder) /var/studio/forms/submissions
create path (sling:Folder) /var/workflow

create service user studio-forms-service
set ACL for studio-forms-service
    allow jcr:read on /content
    allow jcr:read on /conf
    allow jcr:all on /var/studio/forms
    allow jcr:read on /var/workflow
    allow jcr:read,rep:write on /content/dam
end

create service user studio-workflow-service
set ACL for studio-workflow-service
    allow jcr:read,rep:write on /var/studio/forms
end
